name: @openteam/desktop
author: OpenTeam contributors
description: A self-hosted desktop for durable Pi agents with configurable inference providers.

scripts.build:main: bun build src/main/index.ts --outdir dist-electron --entry-naming main.js --chunk-naming 'chunks/[name].[ext]' --splitting --target node --format esm --external electron
scripts.build:utility: bun build src/main/host-utility.ts --outfile dist-electron/host-utility.js --target node --format esm --external electron
scripts.build:preload: bun build src/preload/index.ts --outfile dist-electron/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron
scripts.build:electron: bun run build:main && bun run build:utility && bun run build:server-updater && bun run build:preload
scripts.build: bun run clean && vite build && bun run build:electron
scripts.package: bun run clean:release && bun run build && electron-builder --publish never && bun ../../scripts/performance/check-desktop-budgets.ts --release
scripts.package:mac-release: bun run clean:release && bun run build && bun run scripts/package-macos-release.ts && bun ../../scripts/performance/check-desktop-budgets.ts --release && bun run verify:mac-notifications
scripts.package:mac-local: bun run clean:release-local && bun run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=true -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false -c.directories.output=release-local && bun run scripts/verify-macos-notifications.ts --allow-adhoc release-local
